title: A Constructive Cayley Representation of Orthogonal Matrices and Applications to Optimization
summary: It is known that every real orthogonal matrix can be brought into the domain of the Cayley transform by multiplication with a suitable diagonal signature matrix. In this paper we provide a constructive and numerically efficient algorithm that, given a real orthogonal matrix $U$, computes a diagonal matrix $D$ with entries in $\{\pm1\}$ such that the Cayley transform of $DU$ is well defined. This yields a representation of $U$ in the form \[ U = D(I-S)(I+S)^{-1}, \] where $S$ is a skew-symmetric matrix.
